user.title: Ubuntu Linux host
user.description: Enter the Ubuntu server address. A dedicated Ed25519 key pair will be created.

install.title: Install monitoring account
install.description:
Run this installer on Ubuntu as an administrator (review it first):

{command}

Obtain the server host key fingerprint with: sudo ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub -E sha256

Enter the SHA256:... fingerprint below to test SSH.
